summary: Tested new Add Property media upload functionality for Fairy Star Vacation Homes. The InlineMediaUploader component is working correctly on the Add Property page (/admin/properties/new) with all features functional: Add Image URL, Add Video Link, drag-and-drop zone, remove media, set cover functionality. Edit Property page shows PropertyMediaManager in Media tab with existing images. All UI tests passed.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps Create Property button - blocking click action in automated tests. Manual click may work by scrolling.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Media upload functionality tested on Add Property page (/admin/properties/new). InlineMediaUploader component allows adding images via URL and video links before property creation. When creating a property, media is queued in state and uploaded after the property ID is returned from POST /api/admin/properties. Edit Property page has two tabs: Details (with InlineMediaUploader) and Media (with PropertyMediaManager for existing media). MOCKED: Cloud storage S3/R2 disabled (STORAGE_ENABLED=false), local file storage works via /api/media/ endpoint.

mocked_apis.storage: STORAGE_ENABLED=false - S3/R2 cloud storage disabled, using local file storage
